OCCUPATIONAL ENGLISH TEST
WRTING SUB-TEST:                      MEDICINE
TIME ALLOWED:                       READING TIME: 5 MINUTES
                                     WRITING TIME:40 MINUTES
Read the case notes below and complete the writing task which follows

Notes:
Mr Kenny Stewart is a 60 year old gentleman presenting in your general practice with a swollen left big
toe.

Patient:           Kenny Stewart

Residence:         118 Wharncliffe Drive

                    Surrey,London,UK

DOB:                17.5.1962

SOCIAL HISTORY: Retired nurse

                    Married, 2 adult children

                    Never smoked

                     Binge drinking 17 units of ETOH/weekly

Observations:        BP 110/80 mmHg HR 76 bpm

                     RR 16/MIN

                     Afebrile to touch

FHx:                Father - Died in RTA (40 Years )

                     Mother- Died in Childbirth

                     Unknown history for grandparents

                     Brother – Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA)
 
PMx :               Low birth weight Inguinal

                    Hernia (2008) Annual

                    Influenza Vaccine

                    Previous diagnosis of Gout - lost to follow up (2009)

Medications:        None

                     Previously Offered

                     NSAID’S – Stopped by patient

Treatment record:

20.4.19:            2 weeks history of cough and cold symptoms

                     Found to be febrile, WCC = 18,000

                     Started on 7 day course - Amoxyclav PO

                     Resolved symptoms on follow up

20.5.2019:          Attended for follow up visit

                    Chest X Ray NAD

30.6.19:            2 Weeks H/O Swollen knee joint (Rt)

                    Joint Aspiration – Suggestive of gouty arthritis

                    Started on Colchicine 500mg TDS x 2 weeks

31.6.19:            Patient attended with abdominal cramps and watery diarrhea.

                    ? Drug induced : Advised to continue prescribed medication at

                     BD dose +PRN Loperamide

7.9.2019:           Annual Influenza Vaccine

10.10.19:           Re-attended with swollen left toe

                    Patient very anxious re: RA in brother
 
Patient would not live to wait for rheumatology appointment

                  Wants to be treated by private GP

                  Patient counseled and referred by urgent Rheumatology appointment

                   (1 week wait)

                  Bloods done

0/E:              GOUTY Tophi Left ear, vitals NAD

                  Left knee( Swollen, red, warm to touch), left toe ( swollen ,red, warm to touch)

                  Mild Eczema (face) - has tried new facial

Investigations:     Hb       118/dl (115 – 165/dl)

                   RBC       4.5 (3.80 – 5.50 )

                   PCV       0.40

                   MCV        79

                    WCC         14,000

                   Neutrophils 11,000(78% )

                   X Ray Left Toe :- Mouse bitten appearance


Writing Task: Using the information above, write a letter of referral requesting an urgent

appointment to Dr Wysozynski, Consultant Rheumatology, Kentucky Hospital, USA. Make

sure you mention secondary prevention in view of recurrent attendances.
